subject: geography
title: Nicknames of Indian States
description: Complete list of all 28 states with their popular nicknames

content.overview: Indian states have unique nicknames based on their geography, culture, history, or economy. This is the complete 28-state list from your notes.
keyPoints: Himachal Pradesh: Fruit Bowl of India
Arunachal Pradesh: Land of Rising Sun
Madhya Pradesh: Tiger State of India
Sikkim: Land of Peace and Tranquility
Uttar Pradesh: Sugar Bowl of India
West Bengal: Cultural Capital of India

mnemonics.trick: Fruit Bowl = Himachal | Sugar Bowl = UP | Milk Bowl = Haryana | Rice Bowl = Andhra/Chhattisgarh
mnemonics.explanation: Bowl nicknames: Himachal (Fruit Bowl), UP (Sugar Bowl), Haryana (Milk Bowl), Andhra Pradesh & Chhattisgarh (Rice Bowl)

mnemonics.trick: Rising Sun-Arunachal | Forests-Jharkhand | Marathas-Maharashtra | Festivals-Nagaland | Five Rivers-Punjab | Kings-Rajasthan | Temples-Tamil Nadu | Nizams-Telangana | Gods-Uttarakhand | Buddha-Bihar | Sandalwood-Karnataka | Rolling Hills-Mizoram
mnemonics.explanation: 'Land of' nicknames: Arunachal (Rising Sun), Jharkhand (Forests), Maharashtra (Marathas), Nagaland (Festivals), Punjab (Five Rivers), Rajasthan (Kings), Tamil Nadu (Temples), Telangana (Nizams), Uttarakhand (Gods), Bihar (Buddha), Karnataka (Sandalwood), Mizoram (Rolling Hills)

mnemonics.trick: Jewel of Western India = Gujarat vs Jewel of India = Manipur | Tiger State = MP vs Cultural Capital = West Bengal | Abode of Clouds = Meghalaya vs God's Own Country = Kerala
mnemonics.explanation: Don't confuse: Gujarat (Jewel of Western India) vs Manipur (Jewel of India); MP (Tiger State) vs WB (Cultural Capital); Meghalaya (Abode of Clouds) vs Kerala (God's Own Country)

quiz.question: Which state is known as 'God's Own Country'?
quiz.explanation: Kerala is known as 'God's Own Country'

quiz.question: 'Land of Rising Sun' refers to:
quiz.explanation: Arunachal Pradesh is the 'Land of Rising Sun' (first to receive sunrise in India)

quiz.question: Which state is the 'Sugar Bowl of India'?
quiz.explanation: Uttar Pradesh is the 'Sugar Bowl of India' (Haryana is the Milk Bowl)

quiz.question: 'Tiger State of India' is:
quiz.explanation: Madhya Pradesh is the 'Tiger State of India' (highest tiger population)

quiz.question: 'Jewel of India' refers to:
quiz.explanation: Manipur is the 'Jewel of India' (Gujarat is the 'Jewel of Western India')

quiz.question: Which state is called 'Abode of Clouds'?
quiz.explanation: Meghalaya means 'Abode of Clouds' in Sanskrit
